--- layout: default type_slug: candlestick title: Candlestick Chart in C# — OHLC Price Charts as SVG nav_title: Candlestick Chart description: Render financial candlestick charts in C# with AddCandlestick and OhlcPoint — open, high, low, close with up/down colouring. Self-contained SVG, MIT. permalink: /chart/types/candlestick/ doc_section: Chart Reporting doc_section_url: /chart/ generated_by: scripts/split_showcase.py --- {% capture specimen %} {% endcapture %} {% capture snippet %}{% highlight csharp %}{% raw %} using TerraFluent.Chart.Reporting.Models; string svg = ChartBuilder.Create() .Title("ACME — Daily OHLC") .Size(720, 420) .XAxis("Day", "Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri") .YAxis("Price ($)") .AsAnimated() .Series(s => s .AddCandlestick("ACME", new[] { // OhlcPoint(open, high, low, close) new OhlcPoint(120, 128, 118, 126), new OhlcPoint(126, 130, 122, 123), new OhlcPoint(123, 133, 121, 132), new OhlcPoint(132, 135, 128, 129), new OhlcPoint(129, 140, 127, 138), })) .RenderToSvg(); {% endraw %}{% endhighlight %}{% endcapture %} {% include chart-type-page.html slug=page.type_slug specimen=specimen snippet=snippet %}
